testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/quick-order/verification-single-and-multiple-sku-field-for-guest-user.spec.ts > Webstore - Quick Order > verification of single and multiple sku field for guest user

scenario.summary: Guest uses Quick Order: adds one SKU with quantity 5 from the fly-out, adds two SKU rows (quantities 3 and 5) from Add Multiple Items, and pastes two SKUs with quantities; each submit lands on the cart, which is cleared.
steps: Quick Order fly-out: type the single product SKU, pick the suggestion, quantity productQuantity (5), Add to Cart; cart heading 'Cart' and cart count > 0; clear the cart.

Add Multiple Items: row 0 = first-row product (suggestion '<name> | <sku>'), row 1 = pasted simple product (suggestion '<name> | <sku>'); quantities 3 and 5; cancel empty rows 4, 3, 2; Add to Cart; 'Cart'; clear the cart.
Paste Multiple: '<sku>, 10\n<variant sku>, 5'; toast '2 Products were added to your 'Quick List'.'; clear the cart.
stateChanges: Guest session cart receives the single product (qty 5), the two row products (3, 5) and the two pasted products (10, 5); it is cleared after each step (no order placed).
assertions: Cart heading equals 'Cart' after each Add to Cart; cart count > 0 after the single SKU
Paste Multiple toast contains '2 Products were added to your 'Quick List'.'
evidence: Title 'verification of single and multiple sku field for guest user' and the step labels match the flow; no linked cases, no AIO file.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the webstore every migrated webstore spec runs on (testimEnv.web.baseUrl, webstore-z10-at); same store as the approved pdp/plp/my-account entries.

Suggestion texts are recorded as '<name> | <sku>' (e.g. 'American Standard Gold 95v Furnace | z-1234570'): role data of the product need; the migrated spec builds `${p.name} | ${p.sku}` from the need outputs (name, sku). Names can themselves contain ' | ' (z-1234575 'Daikin FHQ-CB | Multi-Split Air Conditioning Unit').

sku8 z-2410001: profile FOUND active SimpleProduct, inventory 250, storefront index 0 (tda rows: DontTrackInventory, Min 1 / Max 100). Single SKU in the Quick Order fly-out with productQuantity 5 (config): singleProduct = PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 5, minMaxQuantity 5, store}, preferred sku8 (falls back: index 0). The test checks only the cart heading and cart count, not the name.

sku1 z-2460005: profile FOUND active simple, inventory 250, storefront index 1 (Min 1 / Max 100). Row 0 with quantity 3 (spec literal): firstRowProduct = PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 3, minMaxQuantity 3, store}, preferred sku1; sku1 -> firstRowProduct.sku, bosch120voltText -> '<name> | <sku>'.

sku9 z-2430004: profile FOUND active simple, inventory 250, storefront index 1 (Min 1 / Max 100). Row 1 with quantity 5 (spec literal) and paste line 1 with quantity 10: one need pastedProduct = PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK {quantityUsed 10, minMaxQuantity 10, store}, preferred sku9; sku9 -> pastedProduct.sku, sku9Name -> '<name> | <sku>'.

pasteMultipleProductList 'z-2430004, 10\nz-2510001, 5' is built from needs: line 1 = pastedProduct.sku with quantity 10, line 2 = pastedVariant.variant1Sku with quantity 5 (quantities are config, kept in the spec or data). The success message '2 Products were added to your 'Quick List'.' is expected-output: fixed UI text whose count equals the number of pasted lines (2).

z-2510001 (PimProductId 532, SimpleProduct, DontTrackInventory, Min 1 / Max 100, tda rows) is the default variant of configurable B-100004 (approved checkout / saved-cart entries). Need pastedVariant = PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS {quantityUsed 5, minVariants 1, minAddOns 0, minPersonalizableAttributes 0, variantAttributes BulbSize,Color,Technology (the value the approved entries use for B-100004; the test picks no attributes, the param is required)} -> output variant1Sku. No preferred: the recorded variant SKU only appears inside the paste-list string, not as its own source. REVIEW: the key does not check that the variant itself allows quantity 5 (MaximumQuantity) or that quick order accepts a variant SKU; the recording shows it does for z-2510001.

Distinct records: singleProduct, firstRowProduct and pastedProduct are separate PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK needs (distinct SKUs); the two rows must differ anyway, or the duplicate-SKU error would block the submit.
Row quantities 3 and 5 and the cancelled rows 4, 3, 2 are spec literals (config), not scanned values.
migrate: suggestion texts ('<name> | <sku>') and the paste list ('<sku>, <qty>\n<sku>, <qty>') combine several outputs, so they map to no single output (swap rule 2 fails).
